verdict.rationale: Deel publishes only narrow service-level timings: eligibility and visa-option assessments delivered within 48 hours, and case-manager or attorney responses within 24 hours. It publishes no expected end-to-end timelines for the application itself. Live case tracking shows status but is not a published expectation of how long each stage takes. Missing for 10: published provider preparation or filing time for applications, government processing times per visa type or country, and any independent corroboration of the stated SLAs.
